row.proto: void Sess_PuPanel_Set_ComponentSelection(void *component, uint8_t selected, uint64_t item_index)
row.notes: Writes selected to the bool node at +0x230 and its inverse to the bool node at +0x250. When selected it sets the bool node at +0x1b0 of item[item_index] (0x1c8-byte items at +0x170) and takes that item's node handle (+0x10), otherwise the handle at component+0x1b0; the handle is then written as a UIDB reference to the node at +0x1f0. Returns early when selected and item_index is out of range.
